blocks.text: The daily challenge of support email management

Email management for support requires constant context switching. You move from a technical ticket to a billing question and then to a feature request. Each requires a different tone and specific data. If you spend 12 minutes on every email, your queue grows faster than you can clear it. The administrative burden is often what keeps you from hitting your service level agreements.

Most agents spend their time digging through internal knowledge bases or checking past interactions. This manual search is the primary cause of slow handle times. When you use your Mac, you likely have five or six tabs open. Finding the right policy or the correct product documentation takes time. If you can answer out loud, you stay in the flow.
Using voice to speed up ticket responses

You do not need to type every word of a response. When you hold the fn key, you can dictate your thoughts directly into your ticketing platform. Lazur formats your speech into clean, professional text. This works in any browser or app you use for support. You can dictate a draft, review it, and send it in seconds.
Hold fn to start dictating. Speak naturally as if you are explaining the solution to a colleague. Lazur turns your spoken words into a structured email draft at your cursor.
blocks.title: Dictate your drafts

blocks.text: Often, the answer is already on your screen. You might have the customer profile in one tab and the technical documentation in another. Instead of scrolling through both, hold ⌥ ⌘. Ask Lazur where the specific setting or policy is. Lazur will point at the exact spot on your screen. This saves you from hunting for information in long documents.

Complex tickets need research. You might need to check the status of a bug or look up a specific error code. By using Lazur for research, you can open new tabs in the background. Lazur gathers the information and brings back a summary. You then use this summary to build your response. This keeps your main browser window clean and focused on the customer.

As a support specialist, you handle sensitive customer data. Always follow your employer rules regarding client privacy. Do not share personal customer information in any tool that is not explicitly approved by your security team. Lazur does not store your screen data or audio after it answers your request. It is a tool to help you work, not a storage service for customer records.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in my ticketing software?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or operate other apps for you. It points at things on your screen and answers your questions so you can perform the action yourself.

faq.question: Does Lazur work with Zendesk or Salesforce?
faq.answer: Lazur works in any browser or app on your Mac. Since Zendesk and Salesforce are web-based, you can use Lazur to dictate text, ask for information, or find elements on the page while using those tools.

faq.question: Is my customer data safe?
faq.answer: Lazur only sees your screen and listens to your audio while you hold the shortcut keys. This data is sent to an AI provider to answer your request and is not stored or used to train models.
